empty.heading: Hi, I'm Houston, your AI Manager
empty.capabilities: I can do anything you can do in the app: create AI Employees, set up automations, connect your apps, and find what you need.
empty.safety: I'll always ask before anything risky.

failure.title: Houston isn't responding
failure.body: This usually clears up on its own. We keep trying in the background, and you can try again now.

link.unavailableDescription: Check that you are signed in to the Houston account connected to Slack and still have access to this space, then try again.
link.invalidDescription: Open the latest Houston link from your Slack conversation.

say.introManager: I'm Houston, your AI Manager. I build and run your team of AI Employees.
say.introEmployees: Each AI Employee owns one job. They do real work in your tools on their own, and report back when it's done.
say.introHow: You tell me what you need, and I make sure the right AI Employee is on it.
say.connectIntro: First, let's connect the AI that powers your team.
say.surveyIntro: Your AI is connected! Now a few quick questions so I can suggest the right team for you.
say.teamIntro: Thanks, that helps. Here's a starting team of AI Employees for you, the helpers who take work off your plate.
say.teamResume_one: You already have 1 AI Employee on your team. Let's pick up where you left off.
say.teamResume_other: You already have {{count}} AI Employees on your team. Let's pick up where you left off.
say.closingEmployees: Open any of your AI Employees to give them work directly.

closingManager.all: Remember that I'm your AI Manager and I'm here to help. I hand out missions to your AI Employees, hire new ones when you need them, invite your teammates and connect the tools they need.
closingManager.invite: Remember that I'm your AI Manager and I'm here to help. I hand out missions to your AI Employees, hire new ones when you need them and invite your teammates.
closingManager.connect: Remember that I'm your AI Manager and I'm here to help. I hand out missions to your AI Employees, hire new ones when you need them and connect the tools they need.
closingManager.core: Remember that I'm your AI Manager and I'm here to help. I hand out missions to your AI Employees and hire new ones when you need them.

say.closingAsk: What's a task you'd normally do yourself? Tell me and I'll get it done.
say.profileIntro: Hi again! A couple of quick questions so I can tailor everything to the way you work.
say.profileThanks: Thanks, that helps me a lot.

goalCard.title: Starting your goal
goalCard.tip: You can also open any AI Employee to give them work yourself.

goal.hint: Think of the work that eats your week. Houston will put an AI Employee on it.
goal.placeholder: For example: answer customer emails and keep my calendar up to date
goal.tooLong: That's a little long. Keep it under {{max}} characters.
